title: scrumia-impl-rust — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-impl-rust: the ScrumIA implementation slot for Rust — unrepresentable invalid states, typed errors.
tagline: How Rust gets written here — one app at a time.
responsibilities: Owns the how for a Rust app: invalid states made unrepresentable, Result at every boundary, errors typed per layer, one test per invariant, and a file structure the agent follows instead of inventing. Ships an audit skill that measures the gap rather than asserting it.
refusals: No unwrap() in production code, no clone that exists only to appease the borrow checker, no trait with a single implementer.
philosophy: Assumes the type system is where correctness is cheapest to buy. Costs friction at compile time, and a design pass before the first line that a looser language would let you defer.
